summary: Session 61 FINAL retest (frontend only). The Supabase CHECK constraint is STILL NOT widened. Direct REST probe against project vitmvkmjjwabfzndynlj proves the old constraint is live: POST /rest/v1/product_inquiry_leads with product='aktien' -> 201, 'anleihen' -> 201, 'spargeld' -> 201, while 'fonds', 'tagesgeld', 'festgeld', 'flexgeld' all -> HTTP 400 {"code":"23514",..."violates check constraint \"product_inquiry_leads_product_check\""}. i.e. the constraint is still CHECK (product IN ('aktien','anleihen','spargeld')) — the re-run ALTER TABLE did not reach this project/table. Then ran all 6 UI E2E flows anyway (sticky CTA -> product option -> 6 questions [option + 'Weiter'] -> contact fields + 2 consents -> 'Anfrage absenden'): aktien PASS (201, 'Ihre Aktien-Anfrage ist bei uns'), anleihen PASS (201, 'Ihre Anleihen-Anfrage ist bei uns'), fonds/tagesgeld/festgeld/flexgeld FAIL (each: POST /api/submit-product-inquiry-lead 404 fallback, then Supabase 400/23514, no success screen). Payload mapping verified correct for all 6: submitted product == wizard key (fonds/tagesgeld/festgeld/flexgeld/aktien/anleihen), never 'spargeld'. Route regression PASS: /, /handeln, /wissen, /fonds-grundlagen all render (h1=1, zero pageerrors). GREEN COUNT: 8/12 (routes x4, aktien, anleihen, payload-key mapping, wizard mechanics); FAIL: 4 submits + the zero-400 criterion.

critical.issue: DB CHECK constraint product_inquiry_leads_product_check still only allows aktien/anleihen/spargeld. Proof via curl on the live project: aktien 201, anleihen 201, spargeld 201, fonds/tagesgeld/festgeld/flexgeld 400 {"code":"23514","details":null,"hint":null,"message":"new row for relation \"product_inquiry_leads\" violates check constraint \"product_inquiry_leads_product_check\""}. pg_get_constraintdef is NOT exposed via PostgREST (no such RPC -> 404), so verify in the SQL editor. Migration must be re-applied on project vitmvkmjjwabfzndynlj, schema public.
Returns 404 on every submit; client always falls back to direct Supabase insert (works for allowed products, but masks server-side validation and floods console).
